comment: Infrastructure signatures for the iOS simulator leg (.github/workflows/ios-simulator.yml). Rule: docs/releases/V070_IMPLEMENTATION_LEDGER.md, L13. A failed run is INFRASTRUCTURE only when its first failing step precedes the first app assertion AND the pre-assertion log matches one of these. `pattern` is a case-insensitive JavaScript regex. `steps`, when present, limits the signature to failing steps whose name matches that regex. `before`, when present, limits the match to log text preceding the first occurrence of that string. Add a signature only by commit, never while classifying a specific run.
firstAssertionStep: Drive the touch model in Mobile Safari

signatures.note: The hosted runner was lost, shut down or never acquired the job.
signatures.pattern: runner has received a shutdown signal|lost communication with the server|hosted runner (?:encountered an error|lost)|job was not acquired by runner|could not find any available runner

signatures.note: Network or DNS error while fetching Node, npm packages, Appium or the XCUITest driver.
The runner image offers no usable iPhone simulator or runtime.
signatures.pattern: no iPhone simulator is available on this image|runtime (?:profile )?(?:not found|is not available|unavailable)|No available runtime

signatures.note: WebDriverAgent did not answer on port 8100 before the Appium session opened.
